shadow_ai.risk: Rogue LLM instance accepting uninspected internal prompts without Cloud DLP or Model Armor.
shadow_ai.mitigation: Enforce admission controllers blocking unapproved container images and isolate port 11434 via NetworkPolicy.

shadow_ai.risk: Developer instance running vLLM with world-readable local logs logging raw financial prompts.
shadow_ai.mitigation: Quarantine compute instance and migrate workload to managed Vertex AI Private Endpoints.

workbench_vulnerabilities.vulnerability_type: OAuth Token Exposure in World-Readable Logs
workbench_vulnerabilities.risk: Custom startup script writes Google Cloud access token to world-readable disk log (/var/log/startup.log).
workbench_vulnerabilities.mitigation: Update metadata to remove sensitive tokens and redeploy with Shielded VM and CMEK.

workbench_vulnerabilities.risk: Vertex AI Workbench instance is accessible directly via public IPv4 address without Cloud IAP.
workbench_vulnerabilities.mitigation: Disable public IP and enforce VPC-SC perimeter ingress rules.
